task:
Create a DaemonSet named 'ds-important' in namespace 'project-tiger' that runs on ALL nodes, including the control plane.

Requirements:
  - Namespace: project-tiger (create if needed)
  - Image: httpd:2.4-alpine
  - Labels on the DaemonSet AND pods:
      id: ds-important
      uuid: 18426a0b-5f59-4e10-923f-c0e078e82462
  - Resource requests per container:
      cpu: 10m
      memory: 10Mi
  - Must tolerate the control-plane taint so it runs on ALL nodes:
      tolerations:
      - key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane
        effect: NoSchedule
        operator: Exists

Verify:
  kubectl get ds ds-important -n project-tiger
  kubectl get pods -n project-tiger -o wide   # should show pods on every node
hints: DaemonSets run on every node by default except those with taints
Add toleration to spec.template.spec.tolerations to allow scheduling on control-plane
No imperative command for DaemonSets — write YAML
detailed_hints: spec.selector.matchLabels and spec.template.metadata.labels must both include id: ds-important
spec.template.spec.tolerations: [{key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane, effect: NoSchedule, operator: Exists}]

validators.command: kubectl get ds ds-important -n project-tiger -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get ds ds-important -n project-tiger -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels.id}'

validators.description: DaemonSet pods have cpu request of 10m
Desired number of pods equals number of nodes
